info.description: GCC e-invoicing compliance. Generated from the route table by `php artisan platform:openapi` — edit the routes, not this file.

next_cursor.description: Send as ?cursor= for the next page; null on the last

code.description: A platform code named from the status (NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR ...), a named code, or a compliance code (VAL_025, ZATCA_003 ...): docs/integration/ERRORS.md

category.description: Which vocabulary code is from, or the kind of failure: authentication, validation, rate_limit, system, request, license ...

retryable.description: True for 408, 429, 502, 503 and 504: the same request may succeed later

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, on a retryable error that says; also sent as Retry-After

max_retries.description: How many times a retryable compliance error is worth retrying

details.description: Field errors (field => messages) for a 422, or the context the failure carries

WebhookEvent.description: An event a webhook subscribes to (WebhookService::EVENTS), or "*" for every one

signed_xml.description: The document of record: the authority's stamped copy once a standard invoice is cleared

zatca_response.description: The filing: submission_id, state, clearance_status, reporting_status; null when nothing was filed

rejections.description: Only when rejected: each rule broken

id.description: The delivery, the same on every retry of it

data.description: The event's payload; an invoice event's carries invoice_id, invoice_number, status, type, total and currency

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Names one request. A retry with the same key answers with what the first request made instead of making it again. The key is kept with a SHA-256 of the request body (object keys sorted), and the same key sent with a different body is refused: 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
